title: Blue Demon in Trench Coat
description: A blue-skinned demonic figure with large curved horns and glowing white eyes strides forward through a misty stone dungeon corridor. He wears a tattered beige trench coat over a red vest and pants, with clawed blue hands visible, while blood splatters mark the ancient rune-carved walls and floor beneath a single hanging lightbulb.
prompt: A menacing blue-skinned demon with large black horns and glowing white eyes walks directly toward the viewer through an ancient stone dungeon corridor filled with thick fog. He wears a long tattered beige trench coat over a dark red vest and pants, black boots, with sharp blue claws visible. Rune-covered stone arches and bloody splatters on the walls and flagstone floor, illuminated by a single hanging bare lightbulb, dark fantasy atmosphere, cinematic lighting
